verdicts.decision_note: The client establishes a dedicated power button as the machine's master on/off interface and asks where it will be located.
Message 142 is only a freelancer proposal; the authoritative location decision is the client's acceptance in message 143.
The requested rendered appearance is visual styling and does not modify the functional master on/off behavior.
Lighting around the power button belongs to the separate power-button accent-lighting Requirement, not functional master power control.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Ok, that sounds and looks good. Are the spouts going to be removable? That would make cleaning them much easier. I like the press-and-dispense button, and I want each button to have a cursive "K".

value_updates.control_location: centered on the front panel between the two dispense buttons

missing_event_candidates.decision_note: The client's opening acceptance confirms the immediately preceding, uniquely identified front-panel location proposal.
